claim_ceiling: Illustrative social-technical causal fabric; not a universal model of vehicle ownership.

states.persistence_interval: until sale, transfer, theft, loss, or retirement

relations.mechanism_status: legal and practical ownership state follows transaction under local rules
relations.propagation_speed_or_bound: institutional processing, not physical light-speed claim
relations.counterfactual_status: if purchase fails, ownership state does not activate

relations.mechanism_status: use produces convenience and resource burden depending on vehicle and energy source
relations.counterfactual_status: reduced use changes some burdens but not all ownership burdens
evidence_refs: EPA sources of greenhouse gas emissions

propagation_channels.carrier_or_medium: roads, fuel or electricity, law, insurance, repair supply chains
propagation_channels.speed_bound: bounded by physical transport and institutional processing
propagation_channels.attenuation: burdens may decay after sale but residual waste or emissions remain
propagation_channels.amplification: frequent use, high mileage, accident, or lock-in can amplify burden
propagation_channels.transformation: money and time become mobility, emissions, depreciation, maintenance demand
propagation_channels.capacity_or_resource_limit: fuel, electricity, road space, parking, maintenance capacity
propagation_channels.noise: local regulation and use pattern variation

cones_or_horizons.spacetime_scope: owner, household, road network, suppliers, waste chain
cones_or_horizons.reachability_semantics: possible future influence via ownership state and mediated use
cones_or_horizons.horizon_or_boundary: not a proof that every reachable actor is actually affected
cones_or_horizons.coordinate_or_frame_assumptions: ordinary social time and local legal jurisdiction

entropy_and_irreversibility.entropy_production_or_export: fuel/electricity use and material wear dissipate energy
entropy_and_irreversibility.irreversibility_status: some wear, emissions, and waste tails are not fully reversible

scale_transitions.bridge_mechanism: many mediated vehicle-use events aggregate through fuel systems and emissions inventories

projections.observer_or_question: who benefits and who carries costs
projection_rules: separate owner benefits from externalized burdens
unmapped_residue: private preference and exact local outcomes unknown

unmapped_residue.description: Exact local fuel mix, law, mileage, and maintenance history are unknown.

integration_notes.revealed_judgment: A purchase is not a single edge; it activates a persistent state whose benefits and burdens branch across subjects and outlast sale or disposal.
